description.zh: 凭据策略名称。仅支持固定值default。
description.en: The name of the credential policy. Only the static field default is supported.

description.zh:
凭据名称或凭据资源名称（ARN）。
>访问其他阿里云账号下的凭据时，必须输入凭据ARN。凭据ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}`。
description.en:
The name or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the credential.

> If you access a credential that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the credential. The ARN of a credential must be in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}` format.

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 由于凭据策略名称仅支持设置为default，因此查询时凭据钥策略名称（PolicyName）仅支持输入default，否则会提示`Not Found`。
descriptions.en:
- For information about the access policy required for a RAM user or RAM role to call this OpenAPI, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- A credential policy name can be set only to default. Therefore, you must set the PolicyName parameter to default when you query the credential policy. Otherwise, a `Not Found` error is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms get-secret-policy --secret-name secret_test --policy-name default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms GetSecretPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --SecretName secret_test --PolicyName default
